1) IR is a physiological defense against insulin-mediated metabolic stresses in the setting of obesity and 2) the degree of insulin resistance is directly related to the severity of metabolic stress in this setting.

1) insulin resistance is an adaptive physiological defense against metabolic stress; 2) insulin resistance is a normal, healthy, adaptive response in the presence of metabolic stress; and 3) the presence of insulin resistance is a marker of metabolic health.
